meta.title: How it works
meta.description: From the first consultation to regular quality reviews: how we design and deliver a cleaning service tailored to your home or premises in Luxembourg.

hero.title: A service designed around you, then kept consistent
hero.intro: No standard packages and no surprises. We take time to understand what matters to you, then deliver it the same way every visit.

image.alt: A consultant taking notes during a visit to a private residence

steps.title: From first call to lasting routine

items.title: Consultation
items.body: A short call, then a visit to your home or premises at a time that suits you.
points: We assess surfaces, materials and any special requirements
We discuss access, keys, alarms and security protocols
No obligation and no charge for the visit

items.title: Tailored plan
items.body: Within a few working days, you receive a written proposal.
points: Detailed scope and checklist, room by room or zone by zone
Recommended frequency, day and time slot
A clear quote in euros, excluding and including VAT

items.title: Execution
items.body: Your dedicated cleaner or team begins on the agreed date.
points: The same people at the same time for every recurring visit
Eco-responsible products suited to each surface
Keys and badges handled under a documented protocol

items.title: Review
items.body: We check in regularly and adjust the service as your needs evolve.
points: One point of contact for any request or change
Holiday and absence cover planned in advance

promises.title: The details that make the difference

items.title: Same cleaner, same slot
items.body: Recurring clients keep the same vetted cleaner on a fixed day and time.

items.title: Secure key handling
items.body: Coded key storage and signed handovers. Your keys never carry your address.

items.title: One point of contact
items.body: A named coordinator who knows your home or premises and answers quickly.

items.title: Insured and accountable
items.body: Every visit is covered by our professional liability insurance.

items.question: Do I need to be at home during the consultation?
items.answer: Ideally yes, or someone who can show us the premises. The visit usually takes 30 to 45 minutes.

items.question: What happens when my regular cleaner is on holiday?
items.answer: We let you know in advance and send a trained replacement who has been briefed on your checklist. You can also choose to pause the service.

items.question: Do you bring your own products and equipment?
items.answer: Yes. We bring professional, eco-responsible products and equipment. If you prefer specific products for certain surfaces, we are happy to use them.

items.question: Which areas do you cover?
items.answer: We work throughout the Grand Duchy, in all twelve cantons. Cross-border locations can be considered on request.

cta.title: Start with a conversation
cta.body: Tell us what you need. We will arrange a consultation at a time that suits you.
